svg.aria-label: Booth: Small shops in Latin America already sell through WhatsApp, one chat at a time. Booth gives each store a single link with its catalog, turns the cart into a clean WhatsApp message, reserves stock atomically and uses Gemini to read transfer receipts so owners know what to check before confirming a payment.
